transitions.summary: With sight and hearing both obstructed, movement loses every orienting signal and falls directly into a depth covered by compounded misfortune.
A self-defeating viewpoint hides the larger sky while attention remains trapped in small concerns, allowing favorable opportunity to escape unnoticed.
Before assuming authority, the culture hero journeys to a sacred mountain and bathes at dawn, making clarified character the preparation for governance.
A dragon-borne journey meets profitable opportunity, successful capture, and a widening market whose activity settles into durable civic peace.
Authority fails when reckless intimacy and family chaos reach the political center, culminating in a concealed attack and the ruler’s death.
Mountain floods remove the structures that connect the road, trapping the traveler where forceful water has replaced passage with misery.
Fire surrounds the mountain while needed moisture fails to arrive, leaving an isolated household without the communal protection its neighbors require.
Age, weakness, and comparison magnify perceived danger until the threatened creatures surrender their capacity to contend before any fight begins.
Kin and a well-matched young pair meet within a confined lane, where shared music turns close quarters into sociable connection.
An early death transforms companionship into absence, leaving the surviving wife to carry the sorrow of a partnership abruptly cut short.
Raising predators creates danger close to home and courts self-destruction, though the corrupt closing lines leave the final outcome uncertain rather than complete.
A weak field produces a thin and irregular crop, then excessive rain rots even that small yield while containers fill uselessly with water.
Force cannot move the resistant sheep, and speech cannot move those who disbelieve it; frustration twists inward until failed influence becomes personal danger.
Two impaired creatures join forces, but shared limitation cannot create the missing ability, so their combined desire still remains unrealized.
A capable and attractive suitor lacks wealth and reputation, so the family chooses a coarser match and lives with enduring regret.
An impossible birth at an astrologically charged hour signals a world out of order, followed by invasion and the flight of an uncertain ruler.
The direction of events turns from disaster toward favor, with blessing entering the household and previously obstructed action reaching completion.
A teacher survives repeated political confinement, and principled conduct ultimately proves stronger than the forces surrounding him and opens a way out.
Organized predators attack livestock and close the routes, harming cultivation and exchange together by making movement unsafe for every livelihood.
Dreams repeatedly supply the meal that waking life withholds, while fear of insufficiency reflects a livelihood narrowly apportioned.
A foreign chick occupies another bird’s nest while inner and outer relationships rebel, and the original young are driven from their own shelter.
Renowned ministers guide a powerful chariot through every border and direction, making disciplined skill the condition for travel without disaster.
Waste, appetite, stinginess, and greed estrange a person from both celestial and earthly support until the household itself fills with hostile influences.
Rivers and seas hold precious materials and large fish in plenty, but prosperity belongs to the person agile enough to recognize and gather them.
Repeatedly unfavorable timing accumulates trouble, loss, and worry across the years, leaving old age burdened with unresolved grief.
A lifelong search for partnership continues without fulfillment, and repeated hope does not alter the enduring solitary condition.
Solar birds rise over the eastern sea as descendants receive territory, linking cosmic brightness with a lineage of long-held position and resources.
Mutual regard becomes an approach and clasped hands, while fading light still permits the travelers to recognize an elder sister.
When the sage hides far from public life, auspicious creatures also disappear or depart, leaving disturbance to rise without restraint.
After an uncertain start, the road becomes visible, yet purchased animals and received goods immediately escape, leaving only emptiness, blame, and resentment.
The raised head of a poisonous snake compresses violence into a single image whose consequence is three households deprived of their partners.
Capable assistants serve like doors and windows for authority, admitting clarity and translating benevolent action into widespread material well-being.
Downcast participants avoid honest recognition while excessive appetite removes both profit and pleasure, leaving wine sour and food unfit.
Loss of hearing and smell prevents responsible attention, so sacred vessels placed in one’s care are allowed to fall into disorder.
An exceptional harvest fills the granary and supplies rich ceremonial grain, joining material abundance with the capacity to offer thanks.
A hurried royal summons reverses ordinary dress and order, yet service to a renewed eastern court allows the country to rest and recover.
Rare food and elixir accompany fellowship with immortals, presenting a sustained interval in which ordinary sorrow and disaster no longer intrude.
A radiant black dragon turns obscurity bright, and a royal hunt discovers the great person whose arrival will animate the armies.
A person without principle bursts outward when limits loosen, scattering the surrounding group and ultimately losing the family that provided belonging.
Heavenly sweetness descends and the earth receives it, while benevolent rulers convert that reciprocity into recurring years of public peace.
Fish and turtles follow attractive food into hooks and nets, where unexamined appetite converts an apparent gain into capture and death.
Fierce planets, wandering constellations, weapons, and glaring tigers accumulate into a landscape charged with confrontation before battle begins.
An assault on the capital challenges dynastic supremacy, but full military mobilization reverses the attack and defeats the opposing ruler.
Birds flee harmful shadow while a thief watches vulnerable women for advantage; drought and illness widen the atmosphere of exploitation and distress.
Dark clouds gather around thirsty powers and a formally offered drink, but measured hospitality expands beyond proportion into unending rain.
Severe cold, sorrow, and missing offerings deprive the household of warmth and nourishment, allowing an unsettled spirit to haunt the threshold.
Joined creatures arrive in pairs as signs of expanded perception and influence, bringing civic harmony upward into the hall and intimacy into the bedchamber.
Water breaks through its barrier and creates urgent distress, while a practical planting is used to reinforce the damaged place and contain further harm.
